themes.title: Trump Waives Russia Sanctions
themes.blurb: Donald Trump’s decision to temporarily lift U.S. sanctions on Russia is covered across multiple right‑wing outlets, framing it as a peace‑building move while condemning Ukrainian leadership. The story spreads to foreign‑language platforms, highlighting a coordinated narrative that links sanctions relief to domestic economic benefits and diplomatic outreach.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Multiple articles report the waiver, portray it as a peace‑negotiation tool and criticize Zelenskyy.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French right‑wing coverage (via France 24) republishes the waiver story, echoing U.S. framing and adding anti‑EU sentiment.

signals: shared framing of sanctions relief as peace
coordinated messaging across US and French right‑wing media
